sloka: भगवन् दृष्ट वीर्यो मे रामो दशरथ आत्मजः ।अति अद्भुतम् अचिंत्यम् च अतर्कितम् इदम् मया ॥१-६७-२१॥
transliteration: bhagavan dṛṣṭa vīryo me rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ ।ati adbhutam aciṁtyam ca atarkitam idam mayā ॥1-67-21॥

translations.english: "O Worshipful one I have witnessed the prowess of Rama, son of Dasaratha. I had not imagined that this marvellous feat could be ever accomplished.
